content.user_title: Automate Make Operations with Rube MCP
content.value_statement: Make operations data and configuration enums can be hard to inspect from memory. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP workflows for accurate Make automation support.
actual_capabilities: Checks Rube MCP tool schemas before using Make toolkit actions.
Retrieves Make operation records with available filters from the current schema.
Lists supported Make language codes for scenario configuration.
Lists supported IANA timezone identifiers for scheduling workflows.
Validates language and timezone values before they are used in Make settings.
Suggests alternative Rube or native Make approaches when toolkit coverage is limited.
limitations: Requires a configured Rube MCP server and an active authenticated Make connection.
Does not create, edit, or trigger Make scenarios through the documented Make toolkit.
Operation records may be paginated, rate limited, or restricted by account permissions.
Tool schemas can change, so each session should search tools before execution.

use_cases.title: Monitor Scenario Health
use_cases.description: Review recent Make operations, spot failed runs, and summarize error patterns for troubleshooting.

use_cases.title: Validate Configuration Values
use_cases.description: Confirm language codes and timezone identifiers before updating scenario settings or schedules.

use_cases.title: Plan Toolkit Alternatives
use_cases.description: Map Make workflows to Rube tools or native Make API options when the Make toolkit is limited.

prompt_templates.title: List Available Timezones
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Make automation skill to list supported timezones. Confirm the exact identifier for New York and London scheduling.

prompt_templates.title: Review Recent Operations
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Rube MCP to check the current Make tool schema, then retrieve recent operations for the last 24 hours.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Scenario Settings
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate these Make settings before I use them: language is French, timezone is Europe/Paris, and schedule runs daily.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Workflow Reliability
prompt_templates.prompt: Review recent Make operations, group results by scenario, identify high failure rates, and suggest direct Rube toolkit alternatives where useful.

output_examples.input: List the valid timezone values for New York and London.
output_examples.output: The response confirms America/New_York and Europe/London, then notes that exact IANA identifiers should be used in schedules.

output_examples.input: Find failed Make operations from yesterday and summarize the likely impact.
output_examples.output: The response gives a filtered operations summary, highlights failed scenarios, and lists follow-up checks for configuration or account limits.

output_examples.input: Check whether French and Europe/Paris are valid settings for a scenario.
output_examples.output: The response validates the language and timezone values against Make enum results, then flags any mismatch with a suggested exact value.

best_practices: Call RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS before each workflow so parameters match the current schema.
Use narrow date ranges when retrieving operations to reduce volume and quota usage.
Validate enum values before applying language or timezone settings to a scenario.
anti_patterns: Do not assume Make tool parameters from memory without checking the current schema.
Do not request unbounded operation history from active Make accounts.
Do not use display labels when Make requires exact enum identifiers.

faq.question: Does this skill require Rube MCP?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill depends on Rube MCP and the Composio Make toolkit.

faq.question: Does this skill require Make authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. Users need an active Make connection through Rube before account operations can run.

faq.question: Can it create or edit Make scenarios?
faq.answer: No. The documented toolkit focuses on operations data, languages, and timezones.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when Rube MCP is configured.

faq.question: Why should tools be searched first?
faq.answer: Rube tool schemas may change, so searching first helps avoid invalid parameters.

faq.question: Does the skill store credentials?
faq.answer: No credential storage is defined in SKILL.md. Authentication is handled through the configured Rube and Make connection.
